shapes.name: adsr
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification which is shaped like traditional analog attack-decay-sustain-release (adsr) envelopes.

args.name: attack
args.doc: the duration of the attack portion.

args.name: decay
args.doc: the duration of the decay portion.

args.name: sustain
args.doc: the level of the sustain portion as a ratio of the peak level.

args.name: release
args.doc: the duration of the release portion.

args.name: peak
args.doc: the peak level of the envelope.

args.name: bias
args.doc: offset

shapes.name: dadsr
shapes.doc: As *adsr above, but with its onset delayed by delayTime in seconds. The default delay is 0.1.

shapes.name: asr
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification which is shaped like traditional analog attack-sustain-release (asr) envelopes.

args.name: attack
args.doc: the duration of the attack portion.

args.name: sustain
args.doc: the level of the sustain portion as a ratio of the peak level.

args.name: release
args.doc: the duration of the release portion.

shapes.name: cutoff
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification which has no attack segment. It simply sustains at the peak level until released. Useful if you only need a fadeout, and more versatile than Line .

args.name: release
args.doc: the duration of the release portion.

args.name: level
args.doc: the peak level of the envelope.

shapes.name: perc
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification which (usually) has a percussive shape.

args.name: attack
args.doc: the duration of the attack portion.

args.name: release
args.doc: the duration of the release portion.

args.name: level
args.doc: the peak level of the envelope.

shapes.name: linen
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification which has a trapezoidal shape.

args.name: attack
args.doc: the duration of the attack portion.

args.name: sustainTime
args.doc: the duration of the sustain portion.

args.name: release
args.doc: the duration of the release portion.

args.name: level
args.doc: the level of the sustain portion.

shapes.name: triangle
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification which has a triangle shape.

args.name: dur
args.doc: the duration of the envelope.

args.name: level
args.doc: the peak level of the envelope.

shapes.name: sine
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification which has a hanning window shape.

args.name: dur
args.doc: the duration of the envelope.

args.name: level
args.doc: the peak level of the envelope.

args.name: levels
args.doc: an array of levels. The first value is the initial level of the envelope and, when used with EnvGen , is held until the gate opens. If a level is a UGen, it's value is updated only when the envelope reaches that node. When a level is itself an array, the envelope returns a multichannel output (for a discussion, see Multichannel expansion ).

args.name: times
args.doc: an array of durations of segments in seconds. There should be one fewer duration than there are levels, but if shorter, the array is extended by wrapping around the given values.

shapes.name: step
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification where all the segments are horizontal lines. Given n values of times only n levels need to be provided, corresponding to the fixed value of each segment.

args.name: levels
args.doc: an array of levels. The first value is the initial level of the envelope and, when used with EnvGen , is held until the gate opens. If a level is a UGen, it's value is updated only when the envelope reaches that node. When a level is itself an array, the envelope returns a multichannel output (for a discussion, see Multichannel expansion ).

args.name: times
args.doc: an array of durations of segments in seconds. It should be the same size as the levels array.

shapes.name: pairs
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification from coordinates / control points

args.name: pairs
args.doc: an array of pairs [[time, level], ...] if possible, pairs are sorted regarding their point in time

shapes.name: xyc
shapes.doc: Creates a new envelope specification from coordinates / control points with curvature.

args.name: xyc
args.doc: an array of triplets [[time, level, curve], ...] if possible, pairs are sorted regarding their point in time
